xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: In accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, the Company had allotted bonus equity shares in dematerialised form only and bonus equity shares of shareholders holding equity shares in physical form were credited to a separate demat suspense account called RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED BONUS 2024 SUSPENSE PHY. Voting Rights under Category Public include 1 05 59 936 equity shares held in the Unclaimed Suspense Account, 1 50 354 equity shares held in Suspense Escrow Demat Account, 3 81 64 401 equity shares held in RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED BONUS 2024 SUSPENSE PHY and 7 39 82 558 equity shares held by Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority on which voting rights are frozen. As per information furnished by the Promoter and Promoter Group, there are 52 members forming part of Promoter and Promoter Group of the Company, of which 5 promoter group entities do not hold any shares. Pursuant to a scheme of amalgamation approved by the Regional Director, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Western Region, Mumbai, vide its order dated March 19, 2025, Synergy Synthetics Private Limited (SSPL), an entity forming part of the promoter group of the Company, has amalgamated with Reliance Industries Holding Private Limited (RIHPL) effective from March 19, 2025. The 430 equity shares held by SSPL are in the process of being transferred to the demat account of RIHPL. Relatives of Shri Mukesh D Ambani, Promoter and Managing Director of the Company are disclosed under the category 'Relatives of promoters (other than immediate relatives of promoters disclosed under Promoter and Promoter Group category).
